title: Chevy vs Ford vs Ram: Who Is Really Winning the Truck War in 2026?
description:
Ford says it sells the best-selling truck in America, and it has for forty-nine years. General Motors says it is America's full-size pickup leader, for six years in a row. Both claims are true at the same time. And in the third quarter of twenty twenty-six, the brand that grew fastest was neither of them. It was Ram, up almost thirty-four percent, after admitting it made a huge mistake.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
